search_text: published ZDI-18-1291 ZDI-CAN-6203 Apple macOS getsockopt Out-Of-Bounds Access Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2018-10-17 6.9 AV:L/AC:M/Au:N/C:C/I:C/A:C ['Apple'] ['macOS'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on vulnerable installations of Apple macOS. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the getsockopt system call. The issue results from the lack of validating that user-supplied options are of the appropriate size. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code under the context of the kernel. This issue was addressed with macOS High Sierra 10.13.6, iOS 11.4.1, tvOS 11.4.1, and watchOS 4.3.2. title: Apple macOS getsockopt Out-Of-Bounds Access Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on vulnerable installations of Apple macOS. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the getsockopt system call. The issue results from the lack of validating that user-supplied options are of the appropriate size. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code under the context of the kernel.
